gaps.sentence: Who will take ___ from the current director?
gaps.explanation: take over = take control of a job/company.

gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
It took the committee weeks to wade ___ the paperwork.
gaps.hint: wade ___ = plod through a lot of
gaps.explanation: 'Wade through' = work slowly through a large amount of tedious material.

gaps.sentence: The two founders hit it ___ immediately.
gaps.explanation: hit it off = like each other and become friendly quickly.

gaps.sentence: The meeting has been ___ off until Thursday.
gaps.explanation: 'Put off' = postpone to a later time.

gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: The security guard waved us ___ without checking our passes.
gaps.explanation: 'Wave somebody through' = signal them to pass a checkpoint.

gaps.sentence: They get ___ on very little money.
gaps.explanation: get by = manage to survive (with difficulty).
